description: Source code for a wizard interface in an Odoo (OpenERP) module that handles task delegation, including form definitions, field configurations, and business logic for assigning and managing delegated tasks.

classes.name: wizard_delegate
classes.description: Wizard class for delegating project tasks, including methods for assigning tasks and auto-completion.

methods.name: _do_assign
methods.description: Handles copying and updating a task to delegate it to another user, and changing its state based on validation.

methods.name: _ask_auto_complete
methods.description: Prepares default values for the delegation form, including task name and description.
